title: Decision tree DNF for the three-bit sorting function
statement: On the three-dimensional Boolean cube, the DNF function constructed from the decision tree for sorting agrees pointwise with the function that returns $-1$ when the three input bits, obtained by identifying sign $-1$ with true and sign $1$ with false, are in nondecreasing or nonincreasing order, and returns $1$ otherwise.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not include the definition of the decision-tree DNF, so its construction cannot be described more specifically.
